hooks.name: Append Changelog Entry
hooks.description: After every session that makes changes, appends a timestamped summary to changelog.txt in the workspace root.

action.prompt:
Before finishing, append a new entry to the file `changelog.txt` in the workspace root. The entry should be on its own line(s) with the format:

[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] - <short summary of what was changed>

Use the current date and time. Summarize the changes made during this session in one or two sentences. If `changelog.txt` does not exist yet, create it. Always append — never overwrite previous entries.
